cover: Close portrait of a calm, composed Nigerian man in his late thirties standing at a window in early morning light, looking out with quiet resolve, soft rim light on his face, deep indigo shirt, plain bone-white wall behind, generous empty space above his head, contemplative and hopeful rather than sad
result_paper: Overhead view of a person's hands resting in their lap holding a folded blank medical result slip, plain paper with no writing visible, seated on a bench in a quiet Nigerian clinic corridor, out-of-focus background, tension in the hands
clinic: A Nigerian doctor in a white coat sitting beside a middle-aged patient in a modest consulting room, both leaning slightly toward each other in conversation, the doctor gesturing while explaining, warm and unhurried, stethoscope, plain painted wall
agbo: Row of recycled plastic bottles filled with dark brown and murky green homemade herbal liquid, sealed with mismatched caps, standing on a rough wooden roadside table in dappled sunlight, bundles of dried roots and bark beside them, documentary style, slightly unsettling
groundnut: Overhead close-up of raw groundnuts spread across a woven tray, most pale and healthy, a cluster on one side clearly spoiled with grey-green mould and shrivelled discoloured skins, harsh clear daylight showing the difference plainly
storage: Neat shelf of clear airtight containers holding rice, groundnuts, maize and egusi, well sealed and raised off the floor in a clean dry Nigerian kitchen pantry, orderly and calm, soft daylight from a side window
plate: Overhead shot of a balanced Nigerian meal on a plain white enamel plate, grilled mackerel, a generous portion of dark green ugu vegetable, sliced garden egg and cucumber, a small modest portion of brown rice, glass of water beside it, clean wooden table
walking: A Nigerian woman in her forties walking briskly along a quiet residential street at dawn, wearing simple exercise clothes and trainers, mid-stride, long soft shadows, low golden light, purposeful and ordinary
couple: A Nigerian couple in their thirties sitting close together on a sofa at home in the evening, mid-conversation, she is speaking and he is listening carefully with his hand resting on hers, serious but tender, warm lamplight
family: Three generations of a Nigerian family in a modest living room, grandmother, parents and two young children, relaxed together, genuine warmth and ease, afternoon light through a window
vaccine: A nurse in a Nigerian clinic administering an injection into the upper arm of a calm teenage boy who is looking away, gloved hands, clean bright treatment room, routine and undramatic
night: A simply furnished Nigerian bedroom at night, a mosquito net over a neatly made bed, a phone face down on the bedside table, curtains drawn, single warm lamp, quiet and restful
